author: JayTan
quote:
IN CONCLUSION
this game hasnt done anything revolutionary outside of it's optimization of graphics tech (I.e: GI, RT reflections, lighting etc)
the actual core of the game, the gameplay is nothing new and nothing unseen or even a half decent iteration of it's past games, it's an INSULT To call this the greatest game of the generation because it cant even compare to the original ocarina of time, which introduced the world to so many gameplay mechanics and taught both players and developers how to make games
in a bubble, this game is MAYBE 6/10, but to everything that has come before it, it's barely a 4/10


Immense let down **** interms of story and gameplay
For so much anticipation and hype they made, it feels like a false advertisement the way this world restricts you and doesnt allow you as much freedom as past games
the missions are pretty lackluster with only few standouts
the characters fall completely flat without much interest
the game suffers from Rockstar's INSANELY outdated game design that is embarrassingly showing it's age even more in this supposedly monumental game, like i'd dare say it's a regression over GTA 5 and RDR2, it feels like they tried to build a GTA game on top of a Red Dead 2 but failed as the different themes, different  TYPES of game in general 
the morality system itself contradicts the nature of the game, this has gone from a game about the criminal life into a movie game wanting to tell stories too deep for it's own themes and mechanics
